decisions.reason: The About-page copy still says a referral-free purchase creates six tickets, but the source establishes one ticket and one commission per non-promotional mint, including rewards allocated by weighted draw.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The number of commissions and tickets should each equal the number of mints, excluding promotional mints. However, those distributed by weighted draw do not seem to be registering.

value_updates.no_referral_rewards_copy: State that each non-promotional referral-free mint creates one ticket and one commission, with both allocated by weighted draw.
